title: Circulant Hadamard matrices
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: OpenAI's proof (2026) of the circulant Hadamard conjecture: real circulant Hadamard matrices exist only in orders 1 and 4. The first lesson writes the first row in the group ring of the cyclic group, introduces characters and reduces even-length Barker sequences to the theorem. The second proves the local structure of rings of cyclotomic integers near a prime and Turyn's restriction of the order to 4u^2 with u odd. The third compares character values in one prime direction, proves Kronecker's criterion, and shows that alternating products of character values are roots of unity of odd order. The fourth derives the contradiction modulo a prime above 2 from the sign coefficients.
prerequisites: core course Abstract Algebra II (rings, ideals, quotients, localization, Chinese remainder theorem)
core course Linear Algebra (diagonalization of commuting matrices of finite order)
